observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor hall with wooden floor, stage with colorful fabric backdrop, and seated audience at tables
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women of various ages, about 10 dancers total
observation.formation_and_space: line formation facing front, shifting to couples holding hands and moving in a circle or line across the floor
observation.posture: upright torso, soft knees, weight shifting actively from foot to foot
observation.footwork: lively stepping and traveling steps on the beat, low kicks and heel clicks visible
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held by the side or up holding skirts for women; partners holding hands in pairs; arms raised overhead during turns
observation.hips_and_torso: torso upright with natural sway, hips moving with the stepping rhythm
observation.partnering: couples hold hands, spin each other under arms, and drop to one knee together
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing turns, spinning under arms, couples dropping to one knee together
observation.costume_and_props: women wear white blouses, red skirts with white trim, and black shoes; men wear white shirts, dark vests, dark trousers, and dark hats
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and precise weight distribution are obscured by low video resolution and distance

signature_moments.what: couples link hands in a circle and travel sideways while stepping briskly
couples raise inside arms to form arches while turning around each other
all dancers drop simultaneously onto one knee in unison while holding hands with partners
